state_space: Probability simplex over the continuous kernel states, together with lens and packaging selectors and timescale tau.
timescale_family: tau_values derived from the frozen continuous configs
shell-stable tau shell around the working continuous kernel
completion_map_definition: E_{tau,f}(mu) = U_f!(Q_f(mu K^tau)), where Q_f coarse-grains by the lens-dependent packaging and U_f reinstantiates package prototypes.
fixed_point_protocol: Iterate E_{tau,f} from multiple initial conditions until convergence, cycle detection, or saturation; record distinct fixed points across multiple tau values and lens states.
saturation_definition: Saturation occurs when further initial conditions at the checked tau/lens shell do not produce new fixed-point signatures and the completion family stops growing.
p4_from_p5_feedback_rule: If packaging fixed-point complexity or saturation is nontrivial, update the active lens from packaging feedback; packaging can refine the lens state instead of merely being observed.
macro_admissibility_rule: A macro transition is admissible when the completion map converges or saturates with a stable fixed-point family and the packaged object persists under the selected tau/lens shell.
notes: The completion object is mathematically real and distinct from the cocycle object.
Current evidence does not support a broader theorem class than the closed cocycle route.
The fixed-point object is the packaging theorem object, not a packaging score.
